cells.gaps: No public text has been found for Togo Digital 2025, no delivery plan row, and reporting is activity counts only. Governance rows (2021) are outside the 36-month window and nothing is dated in the last twelve months. Successor Togo Digital 2025-2030 is only at consultant recruitment (May 2025, TGO-011/012/013) with no later row; a Global Fund audit (TGO-002, 2025-06-04) reports no coordinated national strategy, which does not outweigh the President's dated word of adoption.
cells.note: Instrument: Togo Digital 2025, adopted per the President (2022) but ended 2025, with Togo Digital 2025-2030 in preparation, so stage 2 flagged lapsed. Stage 3 also fails for want of a public text.
